1. Objective: Retrieve IC50 activity records with provenance for tylophorine and its salt forms tested against the RAW264.7 cell line target.

2. Output: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism

3. Source: molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary

4. Logic: Identify the parent molecule by chembl_id 'CHEMBL493620'. Include the parent and all related salt forms via molecule_hierarchy. Join to compound_structures for canonical SMILES. Join to compound_records and activities on record_id. Filter activities for standard_type 'IC50'. Join to assays and target_dictionary, restricting to target_dictionary.chembl_id 'CHEMBL612557'. Join to docs via doc_id to derive pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi). Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
